CheckTitle: CBR backup policies have sufficient retention
Description: Ensure that CBR backup policies retain backups for at least 7 days.
Risk: A backup policy with insufficient retention duration may not provide adequate recovery options in case of data loss or corruption.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Cloud Backup and Recovery.
3. Select the backup policy.
4. Update the retention duration to at least 7 days.
5. Verify that the policy is applied to the appropriate vaults.

Recommendation.Text: Set CBR backup policy retention duration to at least 7 days.

Notes: Checks if CBR backup policies have retention_duration_days >= 7.
